calibration.arithmetic: float64 norms/median/mean; one scalar; no heldout normalization statistics
calibration.buffer_training: eligible buffered occurrences train first,then source iterator resumes; no recapture/second pass
order: mu=mean raw norm over calibration tokens <=threshold
calibration.position_zero: exclude original document offset0 before counting calibration population
calibration.seal: CALIBRATION.json and CALIBRATION_SEAL.json before every optimizer update including scratchpilots
calibration.source_order: §79 training documents in original manifest order, then pinned FineWeb file/row order

data.context: 512-token nonoverlapping document-local chunks, every tail retained; exclusions use original offsets
data.excluded_target_context: tokens remain in model context; no input-sequence removal
data.storage: stream staged pinned parquet text and tokenized documents; no training-activation disk corpus; bounded calibration RAM and4096-token batches

gate.all_token_FVU: all50000; reported beside filtered gate, no extra rule
gate.checkpoint_selection: final checkpoint only after100M eligible occurrences
gate.empty_or_zero_variance: INCOMPLETE validity stop, no claimed scientific FAIL/PASS
gate.exclusion: original position0 OR raw norm > sealed threshold
gate.primary: pooled centered FVU and dictionary dead fraction on retained tokens
gate.raw_h_source: E35 sealed transfer gate h.npy, all50000 in originalGATE_SAMPLE order

normalization.bias_initialization: first retained scaled training batch only, inherited E35
normalization.loss_units: fixed centered energy of first scaled training batch only, inherited E35; no scale refitting

parity_authority: §139 permits the run-specific §142gate; same sealed original heldout raw vectors are used, and no W1 reader score is produced by this training run

timing.capture_profile: first3full chunks and total calibration elapsed, including I/O/CPU filtering
timing.continuation: actual remaining budget after provider booking carried to §131followup; no new budget inferred
timing.evaluation_profile: 3full256-token encode/decode/CPU moments timings on buffered calibration, no heldout pilot
timing.forecast: elapsedsofar + remaining raw capture chunks forecast from observed retained/calibration-chunk rate * max(median3fullchunk,calibrationelapsed/chunks) +24415*median3optimizer +196*median3evaluation
timing.optimizer_profile: 3 full4096 scratch-only updates, activeAuxK forced; scratchnonexportable
